notes: Stories created for Clinical Trial Snapshot feature per Phase 2 requirements.

change_log.note: Expose trial snapshot via EvaluateCare facade
Validate trial snapshot logic and API
Ensure end-to-end flow from service to UI

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Clinical Trial Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a structured schema for clinical trial snapshot including phase, status, summary, eligibility criteria, locations, and URL. Ensure alignment with existing ClinicalTrials.gov response fields and Pydantic validation models.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Clinical Trial Snapshot Extraction and Normalization Logic
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S2.description: Extend clinical_trials_service to extract required attributes (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) from ClinicalTrials.gov API responses and normalize them into the defined schema, including handling missing or partial data.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Clinical Trial Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S3.description: Integrate normalized clinical trial snapshot into evaluate_care_facade so that trial data is returned in a consistent, structured format to the frontend chat experience.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Clinical Trial Snapshot
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S4.description: Create unit tests for extraction and normalization logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from ClinicalTrials.gov API response through service and facade layers.

EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.title: Frontend Rendering of Clinical Trial Snapshot
EVAL-TRIAL-QUALITY-S5.description: Render clinical trial snapshot data in chat UI using structured formatting (phase, status, summary, eligibility, locations, URL) ensuring readability and safe link handling.
